content.body:
The CA.mle.38 (the "Camel") was a stable platform with an accurate and reliable gun, and proved to be an excellent antiaircraft weapon. The Camel is quick to deploy and get into action against enemy aircraft. For a light AA gun, the CA.mle.38 has a powerful high explosive charge and can bring enemy planes down very quickly, if they are within its effective range.
In Battleground Europe you should deploy this gun to provide a close-in anti-air umbrella over attacking forces; try to set up in a brush line or trees behind your main advance, where your HE firepower will not only be useful against enemy aircraft, but can provide heavy fire-support for your advancing infantry.
When undeployed you are able to move rather quickly, so do not hesitate to relocate ... frequently redeploying is the best way to prevent enemy air and ground forces pinpointing your location.
